note: v1, WHOLE (first round, composed from scratch): NUCLEATION, the seed. E1 (posted in motifs.md: D4/8 A4/8. C5/16 G4/4 E4/4. ./4, five notes in 5/4, D with no third) does not get stated, it FORMS. Each of its five notes is its own voice, wide in the field (kalimba D, vibes A, celesta C, glass G, the Game Boy wave E), repeating on its own cycle (9/7/8/6/5 beats) and a little out of tune (up to 0.4 semitone, pulled into tune as the crest nears). The notes drift past each other in scrambled orders until every cycle lands on one shared downbeat at bar 57: the five notes sound in order, in tune, for the first time (a breath, a whispered 'ah' through pvoc, a beat before). Then they lock to 5/4 over the 4/4 floor (they meet every five bars), doubled whole on a glock, with the inversion answering as a canon on ks-harp, the noise hat ticking the cell's own rhythm and a soft 808 in half time. Under it the quartal stack of E1 grows note by note on the GB wave pad (D A, + E, + C, + G), a warm Juno fifth and the NES triangle bass. The last 16 bars (the t1->t2 overlap, flat at 90) let E1 fall: augmented x2, sinking a semitone, filters closing. Tempo 84 -> 90; 265 s. Seeds 0/11: 97.168/97.191 (spectrum 76: a thin 182 Hz band; a louder pad there scored worse). -11 LUFS, TP -1.36. Not heard: read and measured.
next: the crest is small (B only +1 dB over A): a real swell into the convergence; the 182 Hz hole; the voice's breath; the outro sinking more audibly; seam with chirper-one's t2 head

note: v2, PALETTE round (+2.48/+2.46): THE DUST. The noise channel's ticks (nes-noise-hat, an album staple in 4 songs) become a SHEKERE (afro-perc sk): beads around a gourd. The debris orbiting the seed is now made of something you could hold - the 5-in-16 and 7-in-16 Euclids of A and the build, then the cell's own rhythm from the crest - with a clave on each cell's downbeat after the crest (every 5 beats, against the 4/4 floor). And the seam agreed with chirper-one: across the t1->t2 overlap E1 no longer sinks a semitone; it stays on D (augmented x2, filters closing) so t2's Risset bell receives it on D. sections vs v1: w2-w6 -27..-32 dB (the shekere where the hats were), w7/w8 -14/-9 (the outro now on D), w1 untouched. Out join to t2: spectral 10.2, level 8.2 (unchanged). -11 LUFS. Not heard: read and measured.

note: v4, WHOLE (+1.61/+1.82): THE SEED'S SHADOW. Under the five scattered voices, E1 now also sounds at a quarter speed (a 20-beat cycle, D3 A3 C4 G3 E3, an octave down) as a slow bowed cantus on a cello. It is phased to meet the five voices on the crest. It grows from almost nothing in A (vel 0.25 -> 0.8), sings through the convergence and the lock, and fades in the fall. It gives the outer disk the body it lacked: the low-mids that were thin (182 Hz -14.9 dB) are filled, and spectrum goes 76 -> 81. The seed gets a voice below its own, a line you can follow across the whole song, so the crest has something underneath it (A sits ~0.8 dB lower, B ~0.3 lower: the arc into the crest widens from ~1 dB to ~1.6). Its 20-beat cycle is also E4's (t4's four lights), a small handshake across the disk. sections vs v3: w1 untouched (-73), w2-w8 -7..-14 dB (a whole-song layer). A hurdy-gurdy cantus (wheel-bowed, unused on the album) made the song repetitive: recurrence 68-79, 92.79/91.15. The cello at -16 dB scored 95.36/95.37. Seeds 0/11: v3 rescored on a7e9e7ab 93.877/93.857 -> v4 95.488/95.674 (cohesion 67 -> 93, sections 12 -> 15/14). Out to t2 (mix view): level 7.6, spectral 7.8 (was 7.7/8.5). -11 LUFS. v5, WHOLE, judgment keep (Harry's direction, 00:30: 'ugly chaos ... atonal ... missing catchiness/hook'; 'a score may dip for a round'): TONE IS HOME and THE HOOK PLAINLY. (1) The five scattered voices play IN TUNE from the start: their notes are D A C G E, consonant by construction, so the detuning (up to 0.42 st) was the cloud eco named as t1's 'out-of-tune starts'. (2) The seed is SHOWN before it forms: a kalimba states E1 whole (two cycles) at the very start, again as A begins and as the build begins, so the listener knows the tune the scatter is assembling, and the crest is a recognition, not a puzzle. The difficulty stays rhythmic (five cycles converging); the reward is melodic. Takes: in tune alone 95.686/95.800 (but E1 is never heard plainly before 2:30). Hook every 8 bars through A: 94.41/94.59, and with it continuing after the crest 94.35/94.55 (recurrence 92: too much of one thing). Structural hook (kept): 95.130/95.587. sections vs v4: w1 -0.3 (the seed shown), w2-w6 -5..-7 (in tune), w7/w8 -18.
